text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A reasonably good start,
wouldn't you say?

I was about to ask if something was on her mind,
but—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey! That girl who debuted in Kyoto the other day,
how was she!?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Man, I've got huge hopes for the future! 
How about you?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Expectations don't even begin to cover it!
Man, this year's lineup is incredible.
I can't wait for the Classic year!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "...It seems a lot of people have quite high expectations this year."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
With her current level of readiness,
some concerns remain.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: In order to make our mark in the Classic Triple Crown races—
choice_data_list: As planned, let's get a feel for things at the Keisei Hai

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. Depending on the results, our training methods for the Classic Year will likely change.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: The most important thing is to see the Classic Triple Crown races through to the end. That is everything.
